$comment: Central definition of the five effort tiers (docs/effort.md). It lives inside the effort extension so the extension stays self-contained and extractable; the toolchain (packages/core/lib/effort.ts, the autonomy runner, verify) reads this same file. Effort controls execution depth and breadth only: it never changes the model, its thinking level, the profile or any permission. Limits are defaults, not quotas to consume; users may lower or raise them in <agent dir>/pi-kit/effort.json within the platform ceilings below. Edit the numbers here, not in code.

workflow.$comment: Script workflows (the "workflow" launch kind). Each run opens its own pinned scope in a per-session workflow ledger that the per-turn scope rotation never replaces. workflowConcurrent bounds live agents in one run, workflowTotalPerRun the agents one run may ever start, and workflowSessionTotal the agents all runs in a session may start. These launches never draw on the tier budget or on ceilings.maxTotal. A tier's workflowAgents is the allowance for model-started YAML runs: the worst case of every such run started in one user request, charged before the first launch and never refunded; a tier with 0 opens no run scope at all. An approved script is charged nothing and keeps workflowTotalPerRun.

strategy.$comment: The one decision policy (strategy.ts): what a stall, a large task or a large diff turns into. A move only chooses words: it never changes a tool set, a firewall decision or a tier. planMinTier is the level from which each user message is told to plan (standing mode too); splitMinTier the level from which a task is shaped as a plan, so a directive names workflow_run, a repeated stall or FAIL becomes a split, and a large diff suggests review-changes; delegateScore the complexity score that earns a directive; reviewLines the changed lines of a large diff. stallAfter is the detections of one signal before recovery is called (PI_KIT_GUARD_ESCALATE overrides it), maxAttempts the recovery attempts before the operator is (PI_KIT_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS overrides it), and quietTurns the turns without a signature after which its attempts clear. expandDepth is how many generations of expansion one inline plan may reach: a step with expand answers with more steps, which may themselves expand. Each generation is ordinary steps in the same run, charged to the same allowance, and process depth stays 1.

recovery.$comment: A separate, small budget so a minimal-effort session can still recover from being stuck. It is only spendable while the trusted recovery extension has recovery active (the model cannot switch it on), only for read-only roles, and it never adds to the discretionary budget.

memento.$comment: Memento mode (generations): a long task worked in time-boxed generations that hand over a notebook. Each tier's memento.maxGenerations is the most generations a task at that tier may use (0 means none); it is an allowance, not a target, and it applies only to a model the operator opted in to in <agent dir>/pi-kit/autonomy.json, in the long-horizon and autonomous profiles. A tier never exceeds maxGenerationsCeiling and never falls below the tier before it.
